content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a sample or someone who can explain how to connect three or more [product_name] modules together?
Hi, You may want to check the application examples related to [product_name] for guidance.
Could someone clarify what the terms IB and VB mean for addressing and how they work?

Hi, To note: Address types include: • VB: Variable byte • DB.DBB: Data block byte • MB: Flag byte • IB: Input byte • QB: Output byte These are address formats used for communication with other controllers.
I am able to simulate the connections when using address types, but can't achieve the same result when trying to simulate with IP addresses.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are looking for practical guidance on connecting multiple [product_name] modules, particularly the ones matching [version_no] specifications. Users are confused about the differences between various address types (IB, VB, etc.) and IP address usage for simulation. The existing documentation does not adequately address these needs, creating a demand for more hands-on examples and clearer instructions for setting up networks with [company_name] modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stepwise instructions or example configurations for connecting modules in a network, a thorough explanation of addressing types like IB and VB, and information on how to use IP-based simulation with [product_name] devices.
